name: WF0 - Welcome Message on New Lead

parameters.query:
WITH fallback_token AS (
  SELECT wa_access_token, phone_number_id 
  FROM clients 
  WHERE wa_access_token IS NOT NULL 
    AND wa_access_token <> '' 
    AND phone_number_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND phone_number_id <> ''
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_client AS (
  UPDATE clients
  SET wa_access_token = COALESCE(clients.wa_access_token, (SELECT wa_access_token FROM fallback_token)),
      phone_number_id = COALESCE(clients.phone_number_id, (SELECT phone_number_id FROM fallback_token))
  WHERE id = {{ $json.client_id }}
    AND (wa_access_token IS NULL OR wa_access_token = '' OR phone_number_id IS NULL OR phone_number_id = '')
  RETURNING *
),
current_client AS (
  SELECT * FROM updated_client
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM clients 
  WHERE id = {{ $json.client_id }}
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_client)
)
SELECT c.name as brand_name,
       COALESCE(c.phone_number_id, (SELECT phone_number_id FROM fallback_token)) as phone_number_id,
       COALESCE(c.wa_access_token, (SELECT wa_access_token FROM fallback_token)) as wa_access_token,
       bd_welcome.content as welcome_template
FROM current_client c
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_welcome ON bd_welcome.client_id = c.id AND bd_welcome.doc_type = 'welcome_template'
UPDATE leads SET flow_step = 'welcome', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $('Extract Lead Info').first().json.lead_id }}

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, tenant_id, direction, content, is_ai, sent_at, msg_type, status) SELECT cv.id, cv.tenant_id, 'outbound', $1, true, NOW(), 'template', 'sent' FROM conversations cv WHERE cv.lead_id = $2 LIMIT 1;
